basic_details.job_title: CoPA Senior Dy. Chief Medical Officer Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: MBBS degree and a PG Medical Degree or PG Medical Diploma in the specified specialty from a recognized University, plus the required regular service as Dy. Chief Medical Officer (Specialist) or equivalent specialist post in a Major Port Authority
qualification.details: Qualification: (i) MBBS degree from a recognized University. (ii) A Post Graduate (PG) Medical Degree or PG Medical Diploma in the specified specialty from a recognized University. Plus 3 years regular service as Dy. Chief Medical Officer (Specialist) or equivalent in Rs.60000-180000, or 2 years in that grade and 7 years combined regular service in Rs.50000-160000 and Rs.60000-180000, in a Major Port Authority Experience: Officers holding analogous posts or Dy. Chief Medical Officer (Specialist) and equivalent specialist posts in the Medical Department in the scale of pay of Rs.60000-180000 (pre-revised Rs.13000-18250) with 3 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Authority, or Dy. Chief Medical Officer (Specialist) and equivalent specialist posts with 2 years regular service in the grade and a combined regular service of 7 years in the scales of Rs.50000-160000 (pre-revised Rs.10750-16750) and Rs.60000-180000 (pre-revised Rs.13000-18250) in the specialist cadre of the Medical Department in a Major Port Authority | Other conditions: | Open only to officers in the Medical Department of a Major Port Authority, by absorption through composite method Vigilance status to be furnished in Annexure-V signed by the CVO of the concerned Port

how_to_apply: Fill in the application in the prescribed proforma at Annexure-II.
Get the application certified by the Competent Authority of the parent Major Port Authority.
Attach the documents listed in the circular, including Annexure-III, IV and V.
The parent Port Authority forwards the application with prior approval of the Competent Authority to Cochin Port Authority.
Application must reach CoPA on or before 04.01.2027.
important_instructions: An advance copy is considered only if the application is received through proper channel within 15 days of the closing date Incomplete applications, applications not as per the circular or received after the due date will not be considered Cut-off date for determining eligibility is 04.01.2027 If a major or minor penalty was imposed in the last 10 years, the disciplinary case papers are to be sent by the forwarding authority

content_sections.heading: Key Points
content_sections.text: Last date: 4 January 2027 Vacancies: The number is not stated in the notification How to apply: Offline, by post or in person as the notification says Pay: Rs.80,000-2,20,000 scale of pay Fee: No application fee is mentioned in the notification Place: Cochin Port Authority, Cochin

content_sections.heading: CoPA Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. A8/Sr.Dy.CMO/Med/CoPA/2025-S gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CoPA notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: (i) MBBS degree from a recognized University. (ii) A Post Graduate (PG) Medical Degree or PG Medical Diploma in the specified specialty from a recognized University. Plus 3 years regular service as Dy. Chief Medical Officer (Specialist) or equivalent in Rs.60000-180000, or 2 years in that grade and 7 years combined regular service in Rs.50000-160000 and Rs.60000-180000, in a Major Port Authority Experience: Officers holding analogous posts or Dy. Chief Medical Officer (Specialist) and equivalent specialist posts in the Medical Department in the scale of pay of Rs.60000-180000 (pre-revised Rs.13000-18250) with 3 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Authority, or Dy. Chief Medical Officer (Specialist) and equivalent specialist posts with 2 years regular service in the grade and a combined regular service of 7 years in the scales of Rs.50000-160000 (pre-revised Rs.10750-16750) and Rs.60000-180000 (pre-revised Rs.13000-18250) in the specialist cadre of the Medical Department in a Major Port Authority Other conditions: Open only to officers in the Medical Department of a Major Port Authority, by absorption through composite method Vigilance status to be furnished in Annexure-V signed by the CVO of the concerned Port

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for CoPA Recruitment 2027
content_sections.text: Pay scale granted as financial upgradation under MACPS should not be indicated as it is not regular service in the grade

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Selected officer to be relieved by the parent Port within 30 days of issue of selection order, the post being at Deputy HOD level Period of probation: N.A. as per Recruitment Rule Withdrawal after selection makes the officer liable for debarment from Dy.HOD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for two years

rows.event: Last date for receipt of applications (through proper channel)

content_sections.heading: How Will CoPA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection on merit subject to fulfilling the prescribed eligibility Selection by the Services Selection Committee Selection on merit subject to fulfilling prescribed eligibility Overall ACR grading should not be below Very Good

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Attested copies of APARs/ACRs for the last 5 years (01.04.2020 to 31.03.2025), each page attested by an officer not below Dy HOD rank Statement of year-wise availability of APARs/ACRs and grading signed by the Competent Authority Attested copies of all certificates and proof of educational qualification and past and present work experience Certificate by Head of office as per Annexure-III and No-Objection certificate of the concerned Port Authority Undertaking not to withdraw candidature (Annexure-IV) and vigilance profile signed by the CVO (Annexure-V) Two recent passport size photographs in a sealed envelope

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CoPA Recruitment 2027 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the prescribed proforma at Annexure-II. Get the application certified by the Competent Authority of the parent Major Port Authority. Attach the documents listed in the circular, including Annexure-III, IV and V. The parent Port Authority forwards the application with prior approval of the Competent Authority to Cochin Port Authority. Application must reach CoPA on or before 04.01.2027.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: An advance copy is considered only if the application is received through proper channel within 15 days of the closing date Incomplete applications, applications not as per the circular or received after the due date will not be considered Cut-off date for determining eligibility is 04.01.2027 If a major or minor penalty was imposed in the last 10 years, the disciplinary case papers are to be sent by the forwarding authority

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CoPA Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 4 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for CoPA Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-II of this circular) and send it to Cochin Port Authority, Willingdon Island, Cochin - 682 009, India, by forwarded through proper channel by the concerned major port authority, to reach by 4 January 2027.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for CoPA Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Rs.80,000-2,20,000 scale of pay.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS degree and a PG Medical Degree or PG Medical Diploma in the specified specialty from a recognized University, plus the required regular service as Dy. Chief Medical Officer (Specialist) or equivalent specialist post in a Major Port Authority.

faq.question: Q5. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open only to officers in the Medical Department of a Major Port Authority, by absorption through composite method. Vigilance status to be furnished in Annexure-V signed by the CVO of the concerned Port.

faq.question: Q6. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay scale granted as financial upgradation under MACPS should not be indicated as it is not regular service in the grade.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection on merit subject to fulfilling the prescribed eligibility. Selection by the Services Selection Committee. Selection on merit subject to fulfilling prescribed eligibility. Overall ACR grading should not be below Very Good.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selected officer to be relieved by the parent Port within 30 days of issue of selection order, the post being at Deputy HOD level. Period of probation: N.A. as per Recruitment Rule. Withdrawal after selection makes the officer liable for debarment from Dy.HOD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for two years.
